answer: Cost to a sybil: 500 tokens bonded per identity, locked 90 days, slashed to zero on collusion proof. A 10,000-node attack means freezing 5 million before earning a cent — forgery costs more than fraud pays. The atlas maps every bonded ID, the lantern publishes all slashing events for public audit, and each pearl marks reputation earned only through years of honest settlement, so cheap fake agents stay worthless.
